extensionDescription.message: Dictate into any text field with TypeWhisper and let website workflows match the page you are on.

errorOffline.message: TypeWhisper is not running, or its API server is turned off.

errorUnauthorized.message: TypeWhisper rejected the API token. Paste the current token in the extension.

errorUnsupported.message: This TypeWhisper version cannot receive the active website. Update TypeWhisper.

errorGeneric.message: TypeWhisper could not start the dictation.

hintToken.message: In TypeWhisper, turn on the API server under Settings › Advanced and click “Copy API Token”.

labelReportContext.message: Share the active website with TypeWhisper

hintReportContext.message: Lets website workflows match. The address and title of the active tab only go to TypeWhisper on this computer. Private windows are never shared.

labelShowMicButton.message: Show a microphone button in text fields

hintShowMicButton.message: Needs access to all websites to draw the button.

statusOffline.message: TypeWhisper is not running, or its API server is turned off.

statusUnauthorized.message: Paste the API token from TypeWhisper.

statusUnsupported.message: Connected. Update TypeWhisper to use website workflows from this browser.
